integrity: All mathematical formulas and numerical checks concern the stated family and use explicit surface-gluing and planar area identities. Numerical tests are not substituted for proofs. Review is self-review only.
limitations: Intrinsic surface geodesic distance only, fixed apex to area-uniform target; not a pairwise random distance law or surface isometry. Nondegenerate symmetric regular bipyramids only. Full text of a relevant later skeletal-cut-locus article could not be obtained; historical-priority review is incomplete.
title: Identical apex-distance laws on nonisometric regular bipyramids
